summary: Bug: Adding a part to the Fixed line total increases the Price of the Total by 1 cent.
reported_issue: On a line configured as a Fixed line total, adding a part incorrectly increased the line/total price by $0.01 (a rounding artifact) instead of leaving the fixed total unchanged.
expected_after_fix: Adding a part to a Fixed line total does not change the fixed total; the line total stays exactly the configured fixed amount.
steps_i_followed: Note: creating a fresh fixed line + part in-session was blocked (work-orders/create and parts/create return 500 this session, the documented create-endpoint quirk; the New Line dialog was intermittent).

Instead located a real fixture matching the exact precondition: WO S9-24715 line 6162a6b2 is a 'Fixed line total' (labour_type_id=fixed_line_total, fixed_line_total=300) that HAS two parts added to it (a vendor part qty 2 and an inventory part).
Read the line via GET /api/work-orders/lines/{wo} and the WO via GET /api/work-orders/view/{id} to check the persisted total against the configured fixed amount.
Also scanned 13 other fixed-line-total lines across staging to confirm none carry a fractional-cent residue.
actual_now: The fixed line with parts added shows total_cost = 300.00, exactly equal to fixed_line_total = 300 (no $0.01 inflation). total_parts_sell_price is 0.00 (the fixed total absorbs the parts), and total_labour_cost is 300. The WO total (348.08) equals its finance total. All 13 other fixed-line-total lines likewise show exact totals (e.g. 500=500, 200=200, 3000=3000).
notes: Verdict is based on the persisted state of a fixed line that already has parts added: no +1 cent residue survives on the fixed total. I could not watch the live add action this session (create-* APIs 500, New Line UI intermittent), hence medium confidence, but a per-part $0.01 inflation would have left a 300.01/300.02 residue and the total is exactly 300.00.
